base.note: Single size, no variants (unlike Button). Height and rhythm intentionally aligned with Button.default (identical px/py tokens) so both share the same line height in forms.

radius.note: Gleiche Kette wie Button, siehe button.meta.json base.radius.

states.name: default
states.note: Border (--border/--input) and focus ring (--ring) remain shadcn neutral variables.

states.name: disabled
states.note: Uses shadcn native variables exclusively (--input/50, opacity-50).

states.name: invalid (aria-invalid)
states.note: Shares the exact same shadcn --destructive convention as Button (aria-invalid border-destructive, ring-destructive/20).

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with base classes via cn().

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Base UIs eigene kontrollierte API, alternativ zu nativem value/onChange. Seit Step 7 korrekt typisiert (siehe input.guidelines.md).

passthrough.note: All additional props are passed unchanged to InputPrimitive (Base UI).
